journey.name: fixed quoted request confirmation
journey.description: Two linked test wallets with Paykit enabled. The payer has existing Bitcoin regtest funds; no mainnet payment is needed. Use a USD-denominated request with fixed BTC conversion terms. Reuse the existing confirmation layout and close before paying. Both platforms offer the funding-source dropdown on confirmation.

actions.action: On iOS, use the existing authorized subscription fixture to produce a pre-broadcast failure of an initial fixed USD payment, then choose Try Again inside the subscription sheet. For amountless BOLT11, Savings and LNURL targets, verify confirmation restores the selected quoted BTC amount, not zero or the endpoint minimum. With a recurring fixture, verify confirmation uses the quote bound by the retry’s fresh scan, and unbound terms still require amount review. Repeat with USDT and verify its exact amount and route remain unchanged. Existing fee, affordability and authorization checks must still apply. Close before authorizing or sending. This action requires the controlled pre-broadcast failure fixture; without it, record the missing prerequisite rather than marking the action passed.
Disable USDT on the payer. Create a fixed 2.50 USD request accepting Savings, then open it on the payer.

Verify Preparing changes directly to Confirm without showing a disabled Amount keypad. While initial funding setup is pending, verify the funding dropdown is disabled and cannot silently discard a source choice. After setup finishes, verify a source choice takes effect. While funding setup or coin selection is pending, try the payment swipe and verify no PIN, biometric prompt or hardware signing opens. Verify the exact BTC amount follows the request quote, the fiat equivalent uses the payer wallet rate, and the selected coins and fee are prepared before payment is enabled.

Choose a non-default automatic coin-selection setting, open a fixed quoted Savings request and verify the selected coins and fee follow that setting. Close, choose manual coin selection and reopen; verify the coin picker appears before payment can be approved. Go Back without selecting coins and verify Confirm stays open, allowing a funding change. Swipe again and verify coin selection is still required. On iOS, select coins and continue, then go Back through the coin picker to the original Confirm and verify its fee is recalculated. Close without paying.

On iOS, reuse a paired hardware test wallet with sufficient existing funds and a payer with empty Savings. Open a fixed BTC Savings-only request using automatic coin selection. Verify setup settles on hardware Confirm with a fee, without an Amount detour. Close, select manual coins and reopen; verify hardware Confirm remains usable without opening an empty Savings picker. Repeat both modes with a fixed USD-to-BTC quote. Close without signing or paying; verify each unpaid request can be reopened.
Verify the requested amount cannot be edited and payment does not start without the confirmation swipe. Close the sheet and verify the unpaid request remains available to reopen.
Reopen the same request, then close while Preparing is visible. Verify late completion does not reopen the sheet or start a payment. Reopen once more and verify confirmation is usable.
Open a request whose BTC amount exceeds the payer balance. Verify payment cannot be authorized. Close without paying.
Open a request with a short payment deadline. Let it expire before swiping and verify no payment is sent. Verify fresh payment terms must be reviewed before a retry can proceed.

Enable USDT and open a request accepting both Bitcoin and USDT. Verify confirmation opens without an amount keypad. Open the funding-source dropdown with a paired hardware wallet present. Verify every source label and balance is fully visible, scrolling the menu if needed, and each enabled choice can be reached. Choose USDT and verify confirmation shows the exact quoted USDT amount. Switch back to Bitcoin and verify its amount and fee update without opening the keypad. On iOS, repeat after manually choosing Savings coins and continuing to Confirm. Switch to USDT or LNURL Spending and go Back; verify the previous Savings coin picker cannot reopen under the new asset. If confirmation followed Amount review, Back must return to Amount. No selection should submit a payment. Repeat with a due subscription request and with LNURL Spending plus Savings, then close without paying.

With USDT enabled, open a request accepting Savings and BOLT11 Spending only. Verify it still opens directly to Confirm. If both Bitcoin rails are available, switch between Spending and Savings. Verify valid quoted terms stay on Confirm with the new exact BTC amount and refreshed fees, and still require a swipe. Verify unavailable or expired terms, or a Lightning amount below its minimum, return to Amount for review. On iOS, go Back from that fallback Amount and verify the sheet closes without reopening Amount; reopen the unpaid request and verify the funding choices remain available. Repeat using the interactive edge-swipe Back gesture.

With USDT disabled, open a fixed USD request offering LNURL Spending and Savings with different quoted amounts. Verify confirmation offers both wallets in the dropdown and choosing either shows its exact quoted amount. Choose Spending and verify LNURL confirmation shows that amount; close without paying. Reopen and choose Savings; verify Bitcoin confirmation shows the Savings quote and fee. Close without paying. Repeat with an LNURL-only request whose quote meets its endpoint minimum and verify it goes directly to LNURL confirmation without Amount.

On iOS, open an affordable Savings request that also offers an LNURL Spending quote above the payer’s spendable Lightning capacity. Switch to Spending and verify the payment swipe is disabled and cannot open PIN or biometric authorization; switch back to Savings and verify it remains usable. Repeat with a BOLT11 Spending quote, accounting for its displayed routing fee. When routing-fee estimation fails, verify the swipe stays disabled, Try Again is available, and another funding source can still be selected. Restore an affordable route and retry; verify the actual fee appears and payment becomes available. Verify a successful zero-fee estimate remains payable, and returning from PIN does not discard the reviewed fee. Repeat the failed routing-fee estimate for an automatic first subscription payment from Spending. Verify it stays on Confirm with Try Again instead of showing a payment failure. Restore the route and retry; confirmation must still require a fresh swipe, including after opening a tag and returning. Repeat with a USDT source whose observed balance cannot cover its amount and quoted maximum fee, including a balance decrease after a successful quote. After a USDT send fails definitively before a transfer is stored, verify another source can be selected without closing the sheet. Pending transfers and uncertain failures must keep the request bound to USDT.

Use a fixed USDT request and a quote fixture that returns a bridge minimum or maximum with a numeric limit. Verify confirmation shows the formatted dollar limit without a placeholder, keeps the payment swipe disabled and offers Try again. Retry and verify the same formatted error remains, then close without paying.

On iOS with USDT disabled, open a Savings-only fixed quote for 546 sats. Verify Amount is the first usable screen, Continue is disabled and the sheet remains open after setup finishes. Close and repeat with Savings selected initially because BOLT11 Spending cannot pay; verify the same result. Repeat with exactly 547 sats and sufficient existing funds for fees; verify direct Confirm. Close without paying.

On iOS, open an LNURL-only fixed quote one sat below the endpoint minimum. Verify Amount remains open with Continue disabled after setup finishes. Close and repeat at exactly the minimum with sufficient Spending balance; verify direct LNURL confirmation. Close without paying.

On iOS, use a fixed Savings-only quote covered by the existing balance but leaving too little for its fee. With automatic coin selection, verify failure during coin selection or subsequent fee calculation returns to Amount before a PIN, biometric prompt or signing can open. Tap the top-bar Back arrow and verify the sheet closes without reopening Amount or repeating the failure toast. Repeat after tapping Continue while coin selection still fails or the selected coins cannot cover the amount; Back must close the sheet without exposing a payable confirmation with a hidden fee. Repeat with manual coins that cover the amount but not its fee; Back from the resulting Amount review must also close without reopening Amount. Reopen the unpaid request and verify it is still available. With a request offering both Savings and BOLT11 Spending, reproduce the fee failure, restore normal fees, and tap Continue on Amount. Switch to Spending and back to Savings; verify the exact quoted amount and refreshed fee, with one coin-preparation operation per switch. Go Back to Amount, then Back again; verify the sheet closes without exposing the failed confirmation. No payment may start without a fresh swipe. Close without paying.
